headline: Cold call rejected; prospect objected to how their number was obtained

suggested_routes.label: Sales coaching
suggested_routes.rationale: The prospect asked twice why Arun was calling before hearing a reason, then objected to being contacted on a work number.
suggested_routes.evidence_ref: C01 — "no, I asked why you have called me"
suggested_routes.output: Coaching note for Arun: state the reason for the call in the first sentence. Here the prospect had to ask "Sorry, who is this?" and then "no, I asked why you have called me" before the purpose was clear. Reinforce: Arun answered the data-source question honestly and closed politely when the prospect declined. Manager decision needed: whether this contact should be suppressed from further outreach, given "I didn't ask for this call, and I'm not interested."

suggested_routes.label: Log only
suggested_routes.rationale: Prospect declined clearly and gave a reason; no follow-up is supported.
suggested_routes.evidence_ref: C01 — "I don't think this is something we need"
suggested_routes.output: Log outcome: not interested; prospect states existing processes are already highly automated. No follow-up.

concise_output: Arun's partnership cold call to Pranav (Harborlight Advisory) ended in a clear rejection. The prospect objected to being called on a work number and asked where their details came from. The useful output is a coaching point on opening clarity plus a suppression decision, not a deal action.
what_established: Pranav said he was not interested, did not ask for the call, and considers their processes already very automated. Arun confirmed it was a cold call and named the contact source.
what_not_established: Whether Harborlight Advisory would ever be a fit; Pranav's role or authority. Harborlight Advisory is not established to be related to Harborpath Advisory (M01) despite the similar name.
next_action: Manager to decide whether to suppress this contact; share the opening-clarity coaching point with Arun.
uncertainty: Text is adapted and abridged; tone and exact wording of the opening may differ from the original call.
label_check: Stored observed_outcome 'uninterested' agrees with the text.
